sections.hypothesis: Among liquid coins, holding the strongest 3 and shorting the weakest 3 by 90-day return, weekly, earns money after costs while carrying little of BTC's risk: a second edge that isn't a bet on the market rising. Hypothetical: Kestrel can't short (P5 parked; retail shorting in Australia is CFDs at 2:1, real perps are wholesale-only). A pass is recorded as needs-shorting and never traded until a licensed retail route exists.
sections.rationale: Who pays: investors who under-react to coin-specific news, so winners keep winning and losers keep losing relative to each other. Outside evidence: crypto cross-sectional momentum (Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu 2022, Journal of Finance), found at 1-4 week horizons; 90 days is G1's lookback, chosen to ask whether G1's ranking carries information apart from the market (the outside review's independence point). Not a rejected family. Disclosed: findings 14 found long-only pickers among liquid coins lose with the market; a short side removes the market, which is the point. Universe chosen point-in-time (no survivors-only list). Runs: one, one trial.
sections.rules: Each Sunday close, the eligible coins: BTC, ETH, SOL and the exploration-half coins (never the locked confirmation half), with a median daily quote volume of at least 20M USDT over the previous 30 days, a year of unbroken history, and a USDT-M perp that settled funding that week (so it was shortable). Rank by 90-day return; long the top 3 (spot) and short the bottom 3 (perp), each 1/6 of equity x min(1, 50% / its 30-day annualised volatility). Held for the week, traded at Monday's open. Fewer than 6 eligible coins: cash that week. Decide at each close, trade at the next open (the engine's convention); returns open to open, daily, 2020-01-01 to 2025-10-31 (Binance funding history starts 2020-01; nothing from the holdout). Weights in [-1, 1]: short notional never above equity, inside ASIC's 2:1 retail cap (margin 50% of notional). A short is closed out if a day's high reaches 1.5x its entry (a conservative 2:1 margin call), at that price.
sections.parameters: top 3 / bottom 3, lookback_days 90, weekly (Sunday close), 20M USDT volume floor (as findings 14), vol_days 30, target_vol_pct 50. Nothing else is tried.
sections.costs: Long leg: spot, as kestrel.toml (7.5 bps plus the half-spread band). Short leg: a Binance USDT-M perp only (CFDs on small coins are scarce): 5 bps taker per side (an assumption to check) plus the coin's spot half-spread band, and its real 8-hourly funding (a positive rate pays the short). Every weekly change in weight pays.
